structured_output.what_is_happening: A 12-minute-old ROBIN ("Robin the Frog") token, launched on a Meteora virtual curve and now trading on a PumpSwap pair, has gone about +388% to roughly $283k market cap. In 12 minutes it traded about $2.8M, about 48x its market cap. The canonical-looking ROBIN (pump.fun, ...pump suffix) was created about 33 hours earlier and sits near $10.1M market cap with $293k liquidity. That makes this coin a late copy of an established ticker. Trading is very lopsided: GeckoTerminal shows 694 unique buyers but only 52 unique sellers, and those 52 made about 1,429 sells, roughly 27 each. That pattern suggests bot or wash cycling, or a few wallets distributing into buyers. GMGN flags 20 bundler wallets.

narrative.description: Muppets character meme (Robin the Frog, Kermit's nephew). The narrative already exists and is carried by a $10M token about 33 hours old. This coin is a copy trying to ride that ticker.
narrative.why_spreading: Attention goes to the established $10M ROBIN. This copy's spike is most likely confusion buys and bot or wash volume, not new narrative demand.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has the same name and ticker as the leading ROBIN, and a Twitter/Telegram/website set that may belong to a different 'robincoin' group. It is not the canonical token.
token_connection.competing_tokens: spCPN...pump ROBIN at $10.1M market cap with $293k liquidity is the leader. Nine or more other ROBIN copies exist, mostly dead at $2k-$8k.

authenticity.evidence: 694 unique buyers is real breadth. But only 52 sellers made about 1,429 sells, turnover is 48x in 12 minutes, 20 bundler wallets are flagged, and an image-duplicate count of 4 marks a copy. No paid boosts. The creator launched only 1 token, and GMGN shows the creator position closed.
authenticity.uncertainty: There are no X data. The 80% holder wallet is probably the Meteora curve/pool account, which fits GMGN's 7.5% top-10 rate, but this is unconfirmed. RugCheck says LP is 100% unlocked, while GMGN reports an LP burn ratio of 1.0.

structural_risks: RugCheck flags the LP as 100% unlocked, which conflicts with GMGN's burn ratio of 1.0
80% held by one unlabeled wallet, probably the pool but not confirmed

Going from $283k to $566k needs only modest new inflow at this volume.

structured_output.thesis: This looks like a late copy of an established $10M ROBIN, entered after a +388% move. The volume is heavily inflated by a small set of sellers and there are 20 bundlers. The most likely path is a fade or a distribution dump. It could still spike on confusion buys, so the runner chance is below the pool average but not zero.
